message: Russian and Belarusian languages, terminology, sources and URLs, including .su, are absolutely prohibited. Continue working in English. Leadership Consultant and esoteric roles are excluded. Spiritual Consultant follows evangelical Protestant doctrine: faith in Christ as Lord and Saviour, His finished work, salvation by faith alone and salvation that cannot be lost. Psychotherapist can use major classical schools and newer IFS.
